SELECT id, name_en, station_type
FROM air_quality_station
ORDER BY id

query_oct = text("""
SELECT 
    h.station_id,
    h.datetime,
    h.no2,
    h.pm2_5
FROM hourly_station_air_quality h
WHERE h.datetime >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
  AND h.datetime < '2025-11-01 00:00:00'
ORDER BY h.station_id, h.datetime
""")

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Compute roadside and general averages for NO2 and PM2.5
query = text("""
SELECT 
    aqs.station_type,
    AVG(hsaq.no2) as avg_no2,
    AVG(hsaq.pm2_5) as avg_pm25,
    COUNT(*) as row_count
FROM hourly_station_air_quality hsaq
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON hsaq.station_id = aqs.id
WHERE hsaq.datetime >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
  AND hsaq.datetime < '2025-11-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY aqs.station_type
""")
type_avgs = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print("Averages by station type:")
print(type_avgs)

# Extract values
roadside = type_avgs[type_avgs['station_type'] == 'ROADSIDE'].iloc[0]
general = type_avgs[type_avgs['station_type'] == 'GENERAL'].iloc[0]

roadside_no2 = roadside['avg_no2']
general_no2 = general['avg_no2']
roadside_pm25 = roadside['avg_pm25']
general_pm25 = general['avg_pm25']

no2_ratio = round(roadside_no2 / general_no2, 2)
pm25_ratio = round(roadside_pm25 / general_pm25, 2)

print(f"\nRoadside NO2 avg: {roadside_no2:.4f}")
print(f"General NO2 avg: {general_no2:.4f}")

print(f"General PM2.5 avg: {general_pm25:.4f}")

more_traffic = 'NO2' if no2_ratio > pm25_ratio else 'PM2.5'

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsaq.datetime) IN (7, 8, 17, 18) THEN 'rush'

    AVG(hsaq.no2) as avg_no2,
    AVG(hsaq.pm2_5) as avg_pm25,
    COUNT(*) as row_count
FROM hourly_station_air_quality hsaq
WHERE hsaq.datetime >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
  AND hsaq.datetime < '2025-11-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY period
""")
period_avgs = pd.read_sql(query2, engine)
print("\nRush vs Off-peak averages (all stations):")
print(period_avgs)

rush = period_avgs[period_avgs['period'] == 'rush'].iloc[0]
offpeak = period_avgs[period_avgs['period'] == 'offpeak'].iloc[0]

rush_no2_pm25 = round(rush['avg_no2'] / rush['avg_pm25'], 2)
offpeak_no2_pm25 = round(offpeak['avg_no2'] / offpeak['avg_pm25'], 2)

# Store intermediate results for synthesis agent

_pm25_roadside_general_ratio = pm25_ratio
_more_traffic_dominated = more_traffic
_rush_no2_pm25_ratio = rush_no2_pm25
_offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio = offpeak_no2_pm25

print("\n--- Staged variables ---")

print(f"_pm25_roadside_general_ratio = {_pm25_roadside_general_ratio}")
print(f"_more_traffic_dominated = '{_more_traffic_dominated}'")

print(f"_offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio = {_offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio}")

# Assemble final answer from upstream staged variables

general_no2 = general_avg['avg_no2'].values[0]

print(f"PM2.5 roadside/general ratio: {pm25_ratio:.4f}")
